packageRules.description: Spring Boot gets its own PR: the plugin version sets the BOM that manages the other libraries.
Libraries the Spring Boot BOM manages but the build pins for codegen (Flyway, PostgreSQL). Their catalog versions must equal the BOM's, so review the PR against the BOM before merging.
jOOQ codegen runs in build-logic, outside the Spring Boot BOM, so its version must equal the one the BOM manages. Own PR for that reason.
The OpenAPI generator changes generated code, so its bumps get their own PR and their own review of src/sdk.
NullAway is an Error Prone check and must match the Error Prone version it runs on, so they share one PR.
Gradle wrapper updates are build-tool changes: a label, never automerged.

Vulnerability fixes skip the 7-day wait. Renovate documents that security updates bypass minimumReleaseAge; this rule asks for a 1-day floor, so a release is at least a day old before it reaches a PR.
